subject: Invoice tax routing & VAT ID verification for Aquaterra billing
messages:
From: Hannah Liao <hannah.liao@aquaterra.media>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@aquaterra.media
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Question on tax routing for Redwood June invoice (8741)

Hi Connor,

We've received invoice #8741 for June usage but our AP team flagged that we need confirmation on how the tax was calculated and whether we can apply reverse-charge. Aquaterra is registered in Ireland and our procurement system requires:
- confirmation of Redwood's EU VAT treatment for this particular invoice period
- copy of Redwood's VAT registration or a statement if reverse-charge applies
- whether Redwood is billing gross or net of VAT (we need to know for our ledger)

Can you loop in whoever handles VAT validation? AP is aiming to process payment next week.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Liao
Head of Procurement
Aquaterra Media

Attachment: (none)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Liao <hannah.liao@aquaterra.media>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:01:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Question on tax routing for Redwood June invoice (8741)

Hi Hannah — thanks for flagging and sorry for the churn. Quick update from tax: Aquaterra is in IE and provided a valid Irish VAT number in the PO. For services delivered from Redwood's US entity, the primary question is whether EU reverse-charge applies between our entity and Aquaterra.

I'm attaching a short tax nexus matrix for this account and a copy of the VAT cert we have on file. Summary:
- Aquaterra VAT checks out (attached PDF).
- For EU customers with a valid VAT ID, we generally issue invoices net of VAT and indicate "reverse charge applies" on the invoice.
- If the customer requests, we can provide an EU invoicing statement referencing Article 44/196 (reverse charge).

I'll attach: Tax_Nexus_Matrix_Q2.xlsx and Aquaterra_VAT_Cert_2026.pdf. Connor — can you confirm you want the invoice updated to explicitly state reverse-charge and resend? Also finance needs to know whether to expect a gross-amount payment or net.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Tax_Nexus_Matrix_Q2.xlsx (spreadsheet), Aquaterra_VAT_Cert_2026.pdf (pdf)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Liao <hannah.liao@aquaterra.media>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Daniel Brooks <dbrooks@paymentco.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:37:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Question on tax routing for Redwood June invoice (8741)

Thanks Marissa — and thanks Hannah for the heads up. A few quick clarifications from my side:

- Aquaterra provided VAT IE1234567 in the PO, so per the matrix we should be able to treat this as reverse-charge (invoice net).
- Our standard hosted-hosting billing is supplied from Redwood Inc. (US). We do not have an EU subsidiary billing for this account this quarter, so we typically mark "reverse charge" and leave VAT at 0% when a valid EU VAT ID is present.
- However, AP occasionally prefers a one-line confirmation from us stating Redwood does not collect VAT on this invoice due to reverse charge; we can add that sentence and resend the corrected Invoice-8741-Redwood-2026-06.pdf.

Vivek — can finance confirm whether we should reissue the invoice with a reverse-charge line and whether we will need any additional documentation (signed MRA or W-8 form equivalents)?

Connor
Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: Invoice-8741-Redwood-2026-06.pdf (current)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Liao <hannah.liao@aquaterra.media>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Question on tax routing for Redwood June invoice (8741)

Connor / Marissa — finance here. Confirmed: we should reissue invoice 8741 net of VAT with a clear reverse-charge statement and reference to the relevant EU VAT article. AP will pay the net amount shown. Operational notes:

- Please have the corrected invoice include: (1) Aquaterra VAT number, (2) Redwood billing entity name and country, (3) wording: "VAT reverse-charge applies — customer is liable for VAT under Article 44/196."
- We will not require a signed long-form agreement just to change the invoice text, but please upload the Aquaterra VAT cert to the customer file in the finance drive for audit.
- If Aquaterra insists on paying gross, we can accept but will need a written confirmation and then issue a credit to correct VAT later.

Hannah — finance will reissue once we get explicit permission to send the updated invoice to accounts-payable. If you confirm, we will send a supplant invoice with the reverse-charge line and an attached PDF of our tax statement.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)
From: Hannah Liao <hannah.liao@aquaterra.media>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@aquaterra.media
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 15:45:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Question on tax routing for Redwood June invoice (8741)

Thanks all — that works for us. Please reissue net with the reverse-charge wording and attach Redwood's VAT statement. AP will process the net amount on receipt; if anything changes we'll notify you within 2 business days.

Two quick asks for our records:
1) Could you include a short note on the reissued invoice that says whether Redwood supplied services from the US or from an EU contractor (Aquaterra requires this for our ledger entries).
2) Please confirm the contact for audit requests (if we need further VAT evidence later).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Hannah
Head of Procurement — Aquaterra Media
